capabilities: Apply per-folder sorting orders defined in a sortspec note's frontmatter
List files and folders explicitly to enforce a manual order
Sort automatically by name, creation or modification dates, or note metadata
Extract numbers, Roman numerals, and dates from titles for compound sorting
Drag and drop files into a custom order via Bookmarks integration
extras: Full documentation lives in a separate advanced-README.md and wiki videos; the README points troubleshooting to that advanced document. Warns that advanced recursive modified/created sorting can slow mobile devices on large vaults. Also mentions an unrelated CSS-snippet approach for File Explorer separators.
intentEvidence: folders not set up for the custom order remain on the standard Obsidian sorting
problem: Obsidian's File Explorer offers only global, standard sort options, with no per-folder custom ordering or manual arrangement of notes and folders.

relations.evidence: Thanks to Nothingislost for the monkey-patching ideas of File Explorer in obsidian-bartender

summary: File Explorer plugin that reorders notes and folders per folder via frontmatter sorting specs, explicit manual lists, or automatic rules.
